exposure: Referral from secondary to tertiary care hospitals for obstetric reasons
cohort: 634 obstetric referrals from secondary-level hospitals to tertiary-level care
finding: The most common reason for referral was obstetric indications, and a quarter of referrals were initiated due to medical conditions, mostly infections.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the mode of delivery in 69% of the deliveries.
